E_crit.honest: Was a HIDDEN free parameter, fit to data, no first-principles basis

rho_crit.purpose: Critical volumetric energy density for 2D universe creation
rho_crit.honest: Was a HIDDEN free parameter, fit to data

lambda_th.honest: Was a HIDDEN free parameter, inconsistent with Sun-neutrino constraint

alpha.honest: Phenomenological, not derived. Testable in 2030s by BNS/AGN GW observations

z_half.honest: Phenomenological, gives 1-parameter family F_p(z) = 0.7 + 0.3 × z²/(z² + z_half²)

f_back.purpose: Back-projection efficiency (staying fraction of cascade antigravity)
f_back.honest: Not derived. Set to match observed DE density

epsilon.honest: Not derived. Set to match observed gravity hierarchy

f_deliver.honest: Default full delivery, not derived. Other values possible

f_active.honest: Was thought to be derived, REVERTED in v2.7.1 to phenomenological

F_p.honest: Set to match high-z UV LF. Best compromise, not derived

f_split.honest: Not derived, taken from observation. Universal 32/68 split is POSTULATED

g_plus.honest: Not derived by cascade. MOND empirical value adopted in cascade-MOND hybrid

M_Pl_4_floor.purpose: 4D Planck mass floor from observed 5/27/68 split
M_Pl_4_floor.honest: Comes from cascade's 5/27/68 = 32/68 interpretation. Derived, not free

N_crit.purpose: Critical number of orbits for effective mixing
N_crit.honest: Set to match dwarf galaxy DM content

kappa.purpose: Mixing parameter in dark matter model

E_primordial.honest: §4.48 specifies R_p and F_p but not E_primordial. CRITICAL missing input

epsilon_GW.honest: Used in §10 GW amplitude calculations. Range covers all plausible cases

5_27_68_split.honest: Taken from data, not derived by cascade

H_0_4D.honest: Derived from 5/27/68 split (geometric mean of TRGB and Planck)

summary.verdict: Cascade is honest about its parameters. E_crit, rho_crit, lambda_th WERE hidden free parameters and have been REMOVED in v2.7.5. The remaining 4 free parameters (alpha, z_half, N_crit, kappa) are documented and testable.
